report.title: Send error report
report.intro: The program puts a zip file in Downloads and opens an e-mail that you send yourself. The e-mail cannot add the file by itself, so attach the zip file that File Explorer shows.
report.item_log: The error message and the log file (what the program has done)
report.item_versions: The program's version and the Windows version
report.item_job: The state of the last run and the cuts (without text)
report.never: The video, the audio and the subtitles are never included. Your user folder and user name are hidden in the files.
report.done: "{file}" is in Downloads (File Explorer shows it). Attach it to the e-mail and send it.
report.mail_attach: Attach the file "{file}" from Downloads (File Explorer shows it).
report.button_hint: Sends the log to Kasper so he can see what went wrong.
report.heading: Send an error report to Kasper
